summary: A user's Roles tab manages directly assigned roles for resources like inventories, projects and job templates; inherited team roles are view-only through View indirectly assigned roles. Organization roles are not assigned here. Role labels map components: Automation Execution = controller, Automation Decisions = Event-Driven Ansible, Automation Content = automation hub.
questions: What do Automation Execution, Decisions and Content mean in role labels?
Why can't I remove a role a user inherited from a team?
How do I give a user access to a specific inventory?
Can I assign organization roles from the user Roles tab?
